player_prompt.intro:
Nek adan Player {player_id}. Ad keddinnet Battleship ar tawalt.
Alɣal-innek ad teskɛdet tiɣawsiwin n imaslaɣ-innek ɛad ad teskɛdet tiwinu.
Asmi ad tedduɣ, tzemreḍ ad tesɛɛdeḍ tiɣellisin ɣef yikurdisyen specifik ɣef tawalt-agi: '[a4]'. Maɣa tiɣellsist tɛɛzɛt tiɣawsa, tettwacekkar s 'X'. Maɣa tɛɛzɛt, tettwacekkar s 'O'. Ɣas maɣa, azɣan n waddal ad izen-nek ɣef tiɣellisin-innek. Maɣa teskɛdet tiɣawsa, azɣan n waddal ad izen-nek!
Addal ad yegzu ɣas maɣa tiɣawsiwin n yan imslaɣ ad teskɛdet.
Aseklu-innek amenzu ad nɛɛz tiɣawsiwin-innek akk d tiɣellisin n imaslaɣ-innek ɣef ik, d tiɣellisin-innek d tiɣellisin n imaslaɣ-innek ɣef useklu n imaslaɣ-innek war ad nɛɛz tiɣawsiwin n imaslaɣ-innek.
Hader asaklu amenzu:
